name: When is the best time to consider an assignment sale?

mainEntity.name: When is the best time to consider an assignment sale?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best time to consider an assignment sale, whether as an assignor or assignee, often depends on market conditions and the stage of construction. Assignors might consider it if their circumstances change or if property values have appreciated significantly. Assignees may find opportunities when a project is nearing completion or if they wish to bypass the initial construction wait. Kelby Contreras advises clients on optimal timing, leveraging local market insights across Miami-Dade, Broward, and Palm Beach Counties to maximize potential benefits.
acceptedAnswer.description: Optimal timing depends on market conditions and construction stage; assignors may sell due to changing circumstances or appreciation, while assignees seek nearing-completion projects.
